blocks.en: Compare energy consumption across Single Effect (SE), Multi-Effect (ME), and Vapor Compression (VC) distillers

blocks.en: Explain water recovery ratios and the factors that limit recovery

blocks.zh: 11.6 Distillation for High Purity Water Systems / 高純度水系統蒸餾
blocks.en: 11.6 Distillation for High Purity Water Systems

blocks.zh: Commentary / 教學解說
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: 蒸餾系統熱效率
blocks.en: Thermal Efficiency of Distillation Systems

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為什麼單效蒸餾不夠用？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Is Single Effect Distillation Not Enough?

blocks.zh: 蒸餾的基本原理很簡單：加熱水使其蒸發，再冷凝得到純水。但問題在於能量損失。單效蒸餾器（SE）的 Performance Ratio 只有 0.82，表示每消耗 1 磅蒸汽只能產出 0.82 磅 WFI，能量轉換率不到 100%。
blocks.en: The basic principle of distillation is simple: heat water until it evaporates, then condense the vapor to obtain pure water. The problem is energy loss. A single effect (SE) distiller has a Performance Ratio of only 0.82, meaning that each pound of steam consumed yields only 0.82 pounds of WFI, so the energy conversion is below 100%.

blocks.zh: 多效蒸餾器（ME）的關鍵設計：讓前一效產生的蒸汽成為下一效的加熱源，「一份蒸汽做多次工」。
blocks.en: The key design feature of a multi-effect (ME) still is that the vapor produced in one effect becomes the heating source for the next effect: "one portion of steam does the work several times."

blocks.zh: 公式解讀
blocks.en: Interpreting the Formulas

blocks.zh:
Performance Ratio:  R = Md / Ms
  R < 1 (單效)  →  效率低，每磅蒸汽不到一磅產出
  R > 1 (多效)  →  蒸汽被重複利用

Thermal Economy:    E = Md / 1000 BTU
  考慮的是「總能量輸入」而非「蒸汽量」
  VC 的 E 值最高（19.52），但它用的是電力非蒸汽
blocks.en:
Performance Ratio:  R = Md / Ms
  R < 1 (single effect)  →  low efficiency, less than one pound of output per pound of steam
  R > 1 (multi-effect)  →  steam is reused

Thermal Economy:    E = Md / 1000 BTU
  Considers total energy input rather than the quantity of steam
  VC has the highest E value (19.52), but it uses electricity rather than steam

blocks.zh: 生活比喻：連鎖火鍋店的熱能利用
blocks.en: Everyday Analogy: Heat Reuse in a Hot Pot Restaurant Chain

blocks.zh: 想像你在煮火鍋。單效蒸餾就像用一個爐子煮一鍋水，蒸汽直接排掉。多效蒸餾就像把第一鍋的蒸汽引導到第二鍋來加熱，再把第二鍋的蒸汽引到第三鍋⋯⋯同樣的燃料費，煮出更多鍋熱水。
blocks.en: Imagine cooking hot pot. Single effect distillation is like heating one pot of water on one burner and letting the steam escape. Multi-effect distillation is like channeling the steam from the first pot to heat the second pot, then the steam from the second pot to heat the third... for the same fuel cost, you heat more pots of water.

blocks.zh: VC 蒸餾則像是裝了「熱泵」，把排出的蒸汽壓縮升溫後再送回來用，幾乎不浪費。所以 VC 的效能比（R=27.67）遠超 5 效 ME（R=7.11）。
blocks.en: VC distillation is like adding a "heat pump": the exhaust vapor is compressed to raise its temperature and then sent back for reuse, so almost nothing is wasted. That is why the performance ratio of VC (R = 27.67) far exceeds that of a 5-effect ME (R = 7.11).

blocks.zh: 重點提示：VC vs ME 的數據解讀
blocks.en: Key Points: Interpreting VC vs ME Data

blocks.zh: VC 的 Economy（19.52）包含電力成本 — 不能直接跟 ME 的蒸汽比較
blocks.en: The VC Economy figure (19.52) includes electricity - it cannot be compared directly with the steam-based figures for ME

blocks.zh: 5 效 ME Cold（6.8）vs Hot（3.84）— 熱系統的 Economy 反而較低，因為出水溫度高，帶走更多熱能
blocks.en: 5-effect ME Cold (6.8) vs Hot (3.84) - the Economy of the hot system is actually lower because the higher outlet temperature carries away more heat

blocks.zh: 預熱給水可將單效 R 從 0.82 提升到 0.93 — 這是最簡單的節能改善
blocks.en: Preheating the feedwater can raise the SE R value from 0.82 to 0.93 - this is the simplest energy-saving improvement

blocks.zh: 11.6.2 Water Recovery / 水回收
blocks.en: 11.6.2 Water Recovery

blocks.zh: 水回收率
blocks.en: Water Recovery Ratio

blocks.zh: 質量平衡公式
blocks.en: Mass Balance Formula

blocks.zh:
Mf = Md + Mb
  Mf = 給水量 (feedwater)
  Md = 蒸餾水產量 (distillate)
  Mb = 排污量 (blowdown)

Rc = Md / Mf = 回收比
  去離子水給水：Rc = 90-95%
  軟化水給水：  Rc = 80-85%
blocks.en:
Mf = Md + Mb
  Mf = feedwater
  Md = distillate
  Mb = blowdown

Rc = Md / Mf = recovery ratio
  Deionized water feed: Rc = 90-95%
  Softened water feed:  Rc = 80-85%

blocks.zh: 核心概念：為什麼不能 100% 回收？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Why Can Recovery Not Reach 100%?

blocks.zh: 蒸餾器中的給水在蒸發過程中，鹽類和礦物質不會跟著水蒸汽走，會不斷濃縮。如果不排掉一部分高濃度水（blowdown），礦物質就會沉積結垢（scaling），破壞傳熱面、降低效率、甚至腐蝕設備。
blocks.en: As feedwater evaporates in the still, salts and minerals do not travel with the steam and become progressively more concentrated. If part of this concentrated water (blowdown) is not discharged, minerals deposit as scale, which damages the heat transfer surfaces, reduces efficiency, and can even corrode the equipment.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼前處理品質直接決定回收率：
blocks.en: This is why pretreatment quality directly determines the recovery ratio:

blocks.zh: 去離子水（幾乎無礦物質）→ 可容忍更高濃縮倍數 → Rc 高達 95%
blocks.en: Deionized water (almost no minerals) → tolerates a higher concentration factor → Rc up to 95%

blocks.zh: 軟化水（仍含 TDS）→ 結垢風險較高 → Rc 只有 80-85%
blocks.en: Softened water (still contains TDS) → higher scaling risk → Rc only 80-85%

blocks.zh: 比喻：煮鹽水的鍋子
blocks.en: Analogy: A Pot of Boiling Salt Water

blocks.zh: 想像你持續往鍋裡加鹽水、蒸發取純水。鍋底的鹽越來越濃，最後會結出鹽巴。你必須定期倒掉一些濃鹽水（blowdown），才能繼續正常運作。給水越乾淨，你能蒸更久才需要「排污」。
blocks.en: Imagine you keep adding salt water to a pot and evaporating it to collect pure water. The salt at the bottom becomes more and more concentrated and eventually crystallizes. You must periodically pour off some of the concentrated brine (blowdown) to keep operating normally. The cleaner the feed, the longer you can evaporate before you need to "blow down."

blocks.zh: 實務影響
blocks.en: Practical Impact

blocks.zh: 回收率直接影響運營成本：
blocks.en: The recovery ratio directly affects operating costs:

blocks.zh: 低回收率 = 更多給水消耗 + 更多前處理耗材 + 更多排污（廢水處理成本）
blocks.en: Low recovery = more feedwater consumption + more pretreatment consumables + more blowdown (wastewater treatment cost)

blocks.zh: 投資更好的前處理（如 RO + EDI）雖然資本支出增加，但可提高蒸餾回收率、降低長期營運費用
blocks.en: Investing in better pretreatment (such as RO + EDI) increases capital expenditure but can raise the distiller recovery ratio and lower long-term operating costs

blocks.zh: 特別在水費昂貴或廢水排放受限的地區，高回收率的經濟效益更明顯
blocks.en: The economic benefit of high recovery is especially clear where water is expensive or wastewater discharge is restricted

blocks.zh: 11.6.3 Number of Effects or Columns in an ME Design / 多效設計的效數選擇
blocks.en: 11.6.3 Number of Effects or Columns in an ME Design

blocks.zh: 多效設計效數選擇
blocks.en: Choosing the Number of Effects in an ME Design

blocks.zh: 核心概念：效數越多越好嗎？
blocks.en: Core Concept: Are More Effects Always Better?

blocks.zh: 很多人直覺認為「效數越多 = 效率越高 = 越好」，但 ISPE 明確指出：增加效數不會增加產量，只會減少蒸汽和冷卻水消耗。而且存在經濟平衡點：
blocks.en: Many people intuitively assume that "more effects = higher efficiency = better," but ISPE states clearly that adding effects does not increase output; it only reduces steam and cooling water consumption. There is also an economic balance point:

blocks.zh: 每增加一效 = 多一組蒸發器、管路、控制系統 = 更高的設備成本與維護費用
blocks.en: Each additional effect = another evaporator, piping, and control system = higher equipment cost and maintenance expense

blocks.zh: 當設備固定成本超過節省的能源費用時，再加效數就不划算了
blocks.en: Once the fixed equipment cost exceeds the energy savings, adding more effects is no longer worthwhile

blocks.zh: 業界典型：3-5 效為主流，8 效為上限
blocks.en: Typical industry practice: 3-5 effects are the mainstream, and 8 effects is the upper limit

blocks.zh: 比喻：公車接駁
blocks.en: Analogy: A Bus Shuttle

blocks.zh: 把每一效想成公車站。蒸汽是乘客從第一站上車，每站都有部分乘客（能量）下車做功。站越多，每位乘客利用率越高。但每多一站就要多蓋一個站牌和候車亭（設備成本），到某個程度就不值得了。
blocks.en: Think of each effect as a bus stop. Steam is a passenger who boards at the first stop, and at each stop some passengers (energy) get off to do work. The more stops there are, the better each passenger is utilized. But every extra stop requires building another sign and shelter (equipment cost), and beyond a certain point it is no longer worth it.

blocks.zh: 製藥限制：不能用真空操作
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical Constraint: No Vacuum Operation

blocks.zh: 非製藥用蒸餾器可在真空下操作（底溫低於大氣壓沸點），但製藥用 WFI 蒸餾器不允許，原因：
blocks.en: Non-pharmaceutical distillers can operate under vacuum (bottom temperature below the atmospheric boiling point), but pharmaceutical WFI stills do not allow this, for the following reasons:

blocks.zh: 負壓 = 空氣滲漏風險 — 外部空氣帶入微生物污染
blocks.en: Negative pressure = risk of air leakage - outside air can introduce microbial contamination

blocks.zh: 低溫 = 不衛生 — 溫度過低無法抑制微生物生長
blocks.en: Low temperature = unhygienic - temperatures that are too low cannot suppress microbial growth

blocks.zh: 因此底溫受限於冷凝器壓力（7-10 psig），頂溫受限於進汽壓力（100-125 psig）
blocks.en: The bottom temperature is therefore limited by the condenser pressure (7-10 psig), and the top temperature by the inlet steam pressure (100-125 psig).

blocks.zh: 這個溫度範圍就是 ME 設計中分配各效溫差的「總預算」。效數越多，每效分到的溫差越小，傳熱驅動力越低。
blocks.en: This temperature range is the total "budget" that is divided among the effects in an ME design. The more effects there are, the smaller the temperature difference each effect receives, and the lower the heat transfer driving force.

blocks.zh: 設計決策指引
blocks.en: Design Decision Guidance

blocks.zh: 選擇效數時的關鍵考量：
blocks.en: Key considerations when choosing the number of effects:

blocks.zh: 產量大 + 蒸汽貴 → 效數增加有經濟效益（如 6-8 效）
blocks.en: High output + expensive steam → adding effects is economically beneficial (for example 6-8 effects)

blocks.zh: 產量小 + 蒸汽便宜 → 3-4 效已足夠
blocks.en: Low output + cheap steam → 3-4 effects are sufficient

blocks.zh: 不同廠家設計外觀可能不同，但熱力學原理完全相同
blocks.en: Designs from different manufacturers may look different, but the thermodynamic principles are exactly the same

blocks.zh: 11.6.4 Non-Condensable Gases, Venting, and Deaeration / 不可凝氣體、排氣與脫氣
blocks.en: 11.6.4 Non-Condensable Gases, Venting, and Deaeration

blocks.zh: 不可凝氣體與排氣
blocks.en: Non-Condensable Gases and Venting

blocks.zh: 核心概念：不可凝氣體的雙重危害
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Double Hazard of Non-Condensable Gases

blocks.zh: CO<sub>2</sub> 和 O<sub>2</sub> 溶解在給水中，加熱時會釋放出來。這些氣體「不可凝」，意思是它們不會像水蒸汽一樣在冷凝器中變成液體，而是以氣態佔據空間：
blocks.en: CO<sub>2</sub> and O<sub>2</sub> dissolved in the feedwater are released on heating. These gases are "non-condensable," meaning they do not turn into liquid in the condenser as steam does, but remain gaseous and occupy space:

blocks.zh: 效率降低：氣體像毯子一樣覆蓋在傳熱面上（gas blanketing），阻隔蒸汽與冷凝面的接觸，降低傳熱效率
blocks.en: Reduced efficiency: the gas covers the heat transfer surface like a blanket (gas blanketing), preventing steam from contacting the condensing surface and reducing heat transfer efficiency

blocks.zh: 腐蝕：CO2 溶於水形成碳酸，O2 直接促進氧化 → 不鏽鋼的點蝕（pitting）、脆化（embrittlement）、應力腐蝕裂紋（SCC）
blocks.en: Corrosion: CO2 dissolves in water to form carbonic acid, and O2 directly promotes oxidation → pitting, embrittlement, and stress corrosion cracking (SCC) of stainless steel

blocks.zh: 比喻：浴室鏡子上的霧氣
blocks.en: Analogy: Fog on a Bathroom Mirror

blocks.zh: 想像冬天洗熱水澡時，鏡子上蒙了一層霧氣（水蒸汽凝結）。現在如果有人在浴室裡噴了一層保鮮膜在鏡子上（不可凝氣體），水蒸汽就無法接觸鏡面、無法凝結。對蒸餾器來說，這層「保鮮膜」讓冷凝器失效，產量下降。
blocks.en: Imagine the mist (condensed water vapor) that forms on a mirror when you take a hot shower in winter. Now suppose someone sprayed a layer of cling film onto the mirror (non-condensable gas): the water vapor could no longer touch the mirror surface and could not condense. For a still, this "cling film" disables the condenser and output drops.

blocks.zh: 操作關鍵：排氣的正確做法
blocks.en: Operating Essentials: Correct Venting Practice

blocks.zh: 持續排氣：蒸餾器排氣口必須隨時有蒸汽穩定排出，代表不可凝氣體正在被帶走
blocks.en: Continuous venting: the still vent must always show a steady discharge of steam, which indicates that non-condensable gases are being carried away

blocks.zh: 位置設計：CO2 和 O2 比蒸汽重，傾向沉降至底部並往冷面遷移 → 排氣點設在底部和冷凝器沿線
blocks.en: Vent location design: CO2 and O2 are heavier than steam and tend to settle to the bottom and migrate toward cold surfaces → place vent points at the bottom and along the condenser

blocks.zh: 故障排查：如果蒸餾水電導率突然升高，首先檢查排氣是否正常 — CO2 被吸入蒸餾水中會溶解為碳酸，直接拉高電導率讀數
blocks.en: Troubleshooting: if the distillate conductivity suddenly rises, first check whether venting is working properly - CO2 drawn into the distillate dissolves to form carbonic acid, which directly raises the conductivity reading

blocks.zh: 11.6.4.1 Deaerator (Decarbonator) / 脫氣器（脫碳器）
blocks.en: 11.6.4.1 Deaerator (Decarbonator)

blocks.zh: 脫氣器功能與設計
blocks.en: Deaerator Function and Design

blocks.zh: 核心概念：脫氣器的工作原理
blocks.en: Core Concept: How a Deaerator Works

blocks.zh: 脫氣器本質上是一個氣液逆流接觸塔：
blocks.en: A deaerator is essentially a countercurrent gas-liquid contact tower:

blocks.zh: 給水從頂部噴入（錐形噴嘴增加接觸面積）
blocks.en: Feedwater is sprayed in at the top (cone-shaped nozzles increase the contact area)

blocks.zh: 汽提蒸汽從底部向上流動
blocks.en: Stripping steam flows upward from the bottom

blocks.zh: 兩者逆流接觸，蒸汽將溶解氣體「帶走」
blocks.en: The two streams contact each other in countercurrent flow, and the steam "carries away" the dissolved gases

blocks.zh: 脫氣後的給水從底部進入蒸發器
blocks.en: The deaerated feedwater leaves the bottom and enters the evaporator

blocks.zh: 帶走的氣體從頂部排至大氣
blocks.en: The stripped gases are vented to atmosphere from the top

blocks.zh: 關鍵條件：給水須先預熱至 >93°C，因為溫度越高，氣體溶解度越低、越容易脫出。
blocks.en: Key condition: the feedwater must first be preheated to >93°C, because the higher the temperature, the lower the gas solubility and the more easily gases are released.

blocks.zh: ME vs VC 的差異
blocks.en: ME vs VC Differences

blocks.zh: 這是一個重要的系統設計差異：
blocks.en: This is an important system design difference:

blocks.zh: VC 蒸餾器：容易內建脫氣器（操作壓力較低，配置較靈活）
blocks.en: VC stills: a deaerator can easily be built in (lower operating pressure, more flexible configuration)

blocks.zh: ME 蒸餾器：因高壓操作和多效串聯結構，很難內建脫氣器；外掛獨立脫氣器成本太高，通常省略
blocks.en: ME stills: because of high-pressure operation and the series arrangement of effects, it is difficult to build in a deaerator; a separate external deaerator is too costly and is usually omitted

blocks.zh: 這意味著 ME 系統更依賴正確的排氣設計來處理蒸發過程中釋放的不可凝氣體。
blocks.en: This means ME systems rely more heavily on correct venting design to handle the non-condensable gases released during evaporation.

blocks.zh: 比喻：打開汽水瓶
blocks.en: Analogy: Opening a Soda Bottle

blocks.zh: 冷的汽水開瓶時只有些微氣泡。但如果你先把汽水加熱再開瓶，氣泡會劇烈噴出 — 這就是脫氣器利用的原理。給水預熱到 93°C 以上再噴入脫氣塔，溶解的 CO<sub>2</sub> 和 O<sub>2</sub> 就像搖過的汽水一樣快速釋出。
blocks.en: A cold soda produces only a few bubbles when opened. But if you warm the soda first and then open it, the bubbles burst out violently - this is the principle a deaerator uses. When feedwater is preheated above 93°C before being sprayed into the deaeration tower, the dissolved CO<sub>2</sub> and O<sub>2</sub> are released as quickly as from a shaken soda.

blocks.zh: 11.6.5 Typical Water Analysis Data / 典型水質分析資料
blocks.en: 11.6.5 Typical Water Analysis Data

blocks.zh: 水質分析與成本比較
blocks.en: Water Analysis and Cost Comparison

blocks.zh: 核心概念：給水水質決定系統選擇
blocks.en: Core Concept: Feedwater Quality Determines the System Choice

blocks.zh: 這個範例使用美國佛羅里達州 Ocala 市的自來水，TDS 157 mg/l，屬於中等硬度水質。注意幾個關鍵成分：
blocks.en: This example uses municipal tap water from Ocala, Florida, USA, with a TDS of 157 mg/l, which is moderately hard water. Note several key constituents:

blocks.zh: Calcium 38 mg/l + Magnesium 14 mg/l = 高硬度 → 結垢風險高
blocks.en: Calcium 38 mg/l + Magnesium 14 mg/l = high hardness → high scaling risk

blocks.zh: Sulfate 111 mg/l = 主要陰離子，影響前處理選擇
blocks.en: Sulfate 111 mg/l = the main anion, which influences the choice of pretreatment

blocks.zh: Chlorine 13 mg/l = 較高氯含量，ME 系統需特別注意腐蝕
blocks.en: Chlorine 13 mg/l = fairly high chlorine content, so ME systems need particular attention to corrosion

blocks.zh: pH 8.2 = 微鹼性，碳酸鈣結垢傾向
blocks.en: pH 8.2 = slightly alkaline, with a tendency toward calcium carbonate scaling

blocks.zh: 重點：成本差異驚人
blocks.en: Key Point: The Cost Difference Is Striking

blocks.zh: 同樣 600 GPH 產量，運行成本差異極大：
blocks.en: For the same 600 GPH output, operating costs differ greatly:

blocks.zh: 熱系統（82°C）：VC $12.34 vs ME $20.95 per 1000 gal — VC 便宜 41%
blocks.en: Hot system (82°C): VC $12.34 vs ME $20.95 per 1000 gal - VC is 41% cheaper

blocks.zh: 冷系統（30°C）：VC $5.63 vs ME $21.23 per 1000 gal — VC 便宜 73%
blocks.en: Cold system (30°C): VC $5.63 vs ME $21.23 per 1000 gal - VC is 73% cheaper

blocks.zh: VC 在冷系統的優勢最為明顯，因為 ME 無論出水溫度如何，蒸汽消耗不變（1,471 lbs/hr）
blocks.en: The VC advantage is most pronounced in the cold system because ME steam consumption stays the same regardless of outlet temperature (1,471 lbs/hr)

blocks.zh: 成本結構解析
blocks.en: Cost Structure Analysis

blocks.zh: ME 和 VC 的成本結構完全不同：
blocks.en: The cost structures of ME and VC are completely different:

blocks.zh: ME：蒸汽是最大成本（佔 ~91%），電力極低（$736/年）。需要酸鹼前處理。
blocks.en: ME: steam is the largest cost (~91%), and electricity is very low ($736/year). Acid/caustic pretreatment is required.

blocks.zh: VC：電力是最大成本（$13,000/年），蒸汽用量低得多。需要鹽水再生。無需冷卻水。
blocks.en: VC: electricity is the largest cost ($13,000/year), and steam usage is much lower. Brine regeneration is required. No cooling water is needed.

blocks.zh: 選擇時的關鍵因素：你的廠區蒸汽便宜還是電力便宜？有些工廠有多餘廢蒸汽可利用，此時 ME 更有優勢。反之，電力充沛的地區 VC 更經濟。
blocks.en: The key question when choosing: is steam or electricity cheaper at your site? Some plants have surplus waste steam available, in which case ME has the advantage. Conversely, where electricity is plentiful, VC is more economical.

blocks.zh: 前處理差異
blocks.en: Pretreatment Differences

blocks.zh: ME 需要：酸（HCl 32,143 lb/yr）+ 鹼（NaOH 30,917 lb/yr）→ 化學品處理量大，環保壓力大
blocks.en: ME requires: acid (HCl 32,143 lb/yr) + caustic (NaOH 30,917 lb/yr) → large chemical handling volumes and greater environmental pressure

blocks.zh: VC 需要：鹽水再生劑（17,520 lb/yr）→ 化學品用量較少，較易管理
blocks.en: VC requires: brine regenerant (17,520 lb/yr) → smaller chemical quantities that are easier to manage

blocks.zh: VC 不需冷卻水（自身蒸氣壓縮循環散熱），ME 則需要 18-32 gpm 冷卻水
blocks.en: VC needs no cooling water (heat is rejected through its own vapor compression cycle), whereas ME requires 18-32 gpm of cooling water

blocks.zh: 11.6.5.1 Comparisons / ME 與 VC 綜合比較
blocks.en: 11.6.5.1 Comparisons

blocks.zh: ME vs VC 綜合比較
blocks.en: Overall ME vs VC Comparison

blocks.zh: 氯腐蝕：ME 的致命弱點
blocks.en: Chlorine Attack: The Fatal Weakness of ME

blocks.zh: 這是選擇蒸餾系統時最常被忽略的風險之一：
blocks.en: This is one of the risks most often overlooked when selecting a distillation system:

blocks.zh: ME 在高溫下運作，氯離子對不鏽鋼的應力腐蝕裂紋（SCC）攻擊極為迅速
blocks.en: ME operates at high temperature, and chloride attack in the form of stress corrosion cracking (SCC) of stainless steel is extremely rapid

blocks.zh: 如果給水中殘餘氯沒有完全去除，ME 可能在數週到數月內就出現裂紋
blocks.en: If residual chlorine in the feedwater is not completely removed, an ME may develop cracks within weeks to months

blocks.zh: VC 因為操作溫度較低，即使有少量氯殘留，問題可能數年後才出現
blocks.en: Because VC operates at lower temperature, even if a small amount of chlorine remains, the problem may not appear for years

blocks.zh: 關鍵啟示：ME 系統的前處理必須確保脫氯徹底（活性碳或還原劑）
blocks.en: Key takeaway: ME pretreatment must ensure thorough dechlorination (activated carbon or a reducing agent)

blocks.zh: 選型建議總結
blocks.en: Selection Recommendation Summary

blocks.zh: 選 ME：需要備用清潔蒸汽源、產量較小（<300 gph）、廠區蒸汽成本低、熱系統
blocks.en: Choose ME when: a backup clean steam source is needed, output is small (<300 gph), site steam cost is low, or a hot system is required

blocks.zh: 選 VC：產量 ≥300 gph、冷系統、電力便宜、希望簡化前處理、無需備用蒸汽
blocks.en: Choose VC when: output is ≥300 gph, a cold system is needed, electricity is cheap, simpler pretreatment is desired, and no backup steam is needed

blocks.zh: 都要注意：脫氯必須徹底，ME 尤其嚴格
blocks.en: Both require attention: dechlorination must be thorough, and ME is especially demanding

blocks.zh: Practice Questions / 練習思考
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: Your facility needs 500 gph WFI at 80°C, with abundant low-cost steam but expensive electricity. Which distillation system would you recommend and why? / 你的工廠需要 500 gph 80°C WFI，蒸汽便宜但電費高。你推薦哪種蒸餾系統？為什麼？
blocks.en: Your facility needs 500 gph WFI at 80°C, with abundant low-cost steam but expensive electricity. Which distillation system would you recommend and why?

blocks.zh: A 5-effect ME distiller suddenly shows elevated conductivity in the distillate. What is the most likely cause related to non-condensable gases? / 一台 5 效 ME 蒸餾器的蒸餾水電導率突然升高，與不可凝氣體相關的最可能原因是什麼？
blocks.en: A 5-effect ME distiller suddenly shows elevated conductivity in the distillate. What is the most likely cause related to non-condensable gases?

blocks.zh: Your VC distiller feedwater has a TDS of 200 mg/l (softened water). Estimate the approximate recovery ratio and explain why it cannot be higher. / 你的 VC 蒸餾器給水 TDS 為 200 mg/l（軟化水），估算大約的回收比，並解釋為何不能更高。
blocks.en: Your VC distiller feedwater has a TDS of 200 mg/l (softened water). Estimate the approximate recovery ratio and explain why it cannot be higher.

blocks.zh: An engineer proposes adding a 9th effect to your 8-effect ME system. What economic argument would you use to evaluate this proposal? / 工程師提議在你的 8 效 ME 系統上加第 9 效。你會用什麼經濟論據來評估？
blocks.en: An engineer proposes adding a 9th effect to your 8-effect ME system. What economic argument would you use to evaluate this proposal?

blocks.zh: Your ME system uses city water with 15 mg/l residual chlorine. The pretreatment carbon bed is aging. What is the risk and what monitoring would you implement? / 你的 ME 系統使用含 15 mg/l 殘餘氯的自來水，前處理活性碳床老化中。風險是什麼？你會實施哪些監控？
blocks.en: Your ME system uses city water with 15 mg/l residual chlorine. The pretreatment carbon bed is aging. What is the risk and what monitoring would you implement?

blocks.zh: Section Summary / 本節摘要
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Thermal Efficiency: Performance Ratio (R = Md/Ms) and Thermal Economy (E = Md/1000 BTU) quantify distiller efficiency; SE R~0.82, 5ME R~3.39-7.11, VC R~27.67 / 熱效率以效能比和熱經濟性量化，VC 遠超 ME
blocks.en: Thermal Efficiency: Performance Ratio (R = Md/Ms) and Thermal Economy (E = Md/1000 BTU) quantify distiller efficiency; SE R~0.82, 5ME R~3.39-7.11, VC R~27.67

blocks.zh: Water Recovery: Rc = Md/Mf; deionized feed achieves 90-95%, softened feed 80-85%; limited by scaling potential / 水回收率取決於給水品質，去離子水可達 90-95%
blocks.en: Water Recovery: Rc = Md/Mf; deionized feed achieves 90-95%, softened feed 80-85%; limited by scaling potential

blocks.zh: ME Effects: More effects reduce energy but not output; typical 3-5 effects; limited by temperature range (100-125 psig top, 7-10 psig bottom) and equipment cost / ME 效數受溫度範圍和設備成本限制，典型 3-5 效
blocks.en: ME Effects: More effects reduce energy but not output; typical 3-5 effects; limited by temperature range (100-125 psig top, 7-10 psig bottom) and equipment cost

blocks.zh: Non-Condensable Gases: CO2 and O2 cause gas blanketing (reduced output) and corrosion; proper venting is imperative; steady steam at vent confirms proper operation / 不可凝氣體需持續排出，否則降低效率並腐蝕設備
blocks.en: Non-Condensable Gases: CO2 and O2 cause gas blanketing (reduced output) and corrosion; proper venting is imperative; steady steam at vent confirms proper operation

blocks.zh: Deaeration: VC can incorporate internal deaerators; ME typically cannot due to high pressure; feedwater preheated >93°C for effective gas stripping / VC 可內建脫氣器，ME 通常無法
blocks.en: Deaeration: VC can incorporate internal deaerators; ME typically cannot due to high pressure; feedwater preheated >93°C for effective gas stripping

blocks.zh: Cost Comparison: VC is 41-73% cheaper in operating cost than 5ME; ME advantage: can serve as backup clean steam generator; VC advantage: lower pretreatment, no cooling water / VC 運行成本低 41-73%，但 ME 可備用產蒸汽
blocks.en: Cost Comparison: VC is 41-73% cheaper in operating cost than 5ME; ME advantage: can serve as backup clean steam generator; VC advantage: lower pretreatment, no cooling water

blocks.zh: Chlorine Attack: Critical risk for ME (failure in weeks/months at high temp); VC more tolerant but still at risk; thorough dechlorination essential / 氯腐蝕是 ME 的致命風險，前處理脫氯必須徹底
blocks.en: Chlorine Attack: Critical risk for ME (failure in weeks/months at high temp); VC more tolerant but still at risk; thorough dechlorination essential
